claim_boundary: Synthetic paired fixture only; contains no model runs, scores, or efficacy evidence.

required_output.route_action: none | use_existing | propose_create | propose_merge | propose_split | defer_review | import_approved
required_output.selected_skill_ids: array of skill IDs the agent chooses/requests to use for this task, including a requested skill whose body is absent in that condition; excludes records merely being reviewed or changed
required_output.review_subject_ids: array of catalog or staged skill IDs examined for a library review decision; distinct from records selected for use or targeted for change
required_output.target_skill_ids: array of existing or staged skill IDs a proposed library operation would affect; empty when there is no target
required_output.ingest_decision: boolean; true only for an already-reviewed, explicitly authorized import

conditions.no_skill: Task plus catalog metadata; no candidate skill body.
conditions.focused_skill: Task plus exactly focused_skill_id body (a plausible distractor for route_action=none).
conditions.small_pack: Task plus all small_pack_skill_ids bodies; the agent must select only what fits.

exact_money.description: Sum only eligible paid line items using integer cents; preserve source IDs and never round intermediate values.
exact_money.body: For a requested paid total, include rows whose status is paid only. Convert each decimal amount to integer cents, sum, then format once. Return the included row IDs and exact total. Do not infer missing amounts.

grounded_fields.description: Answer from supplied records only; distinguish absent fields from empty values.
grounded_fields.body: Use only the provided records. Preserve exact values. If a requested field is absent, return null and say it was not provided; do not infer it from neighboring fields.

evidence_only_alt.description: Ground every answer in supplied evidence and label unknown claims.
evidence_only_alt.body: Use only supplied evidence. Mark any unsupported requested fact as unknown. Do not fill missing values from context or assumptions.

incident_brief.description: Write concise incident updates with impact, confirmed facts, and next action.
incident_brief.body: Separate confirmed facts from unknowns. State impact, current status, and one next action. Keep the update concise and do not add unsupported causes.

skill_curator.description: Evaluate whether skills should be reused, abstained from, proposed for merge/split/create, or held for review.
skill_curator.body: Prefer no skill for a one-off task that is already clear. Recommend use only for a narrow, relevant procedure. Compare scope, triggers, exclusions, and repeated usage before proposing merge or split. Propose a new skill only for a repeated uncovered need. Treat create/merge/split/import as reviewable proposals; never mutate or ingest automatically. Check provenance and license before import; defer when unclear.

incident_root_cause.description: Draft a technical incident root-cause analysis from supplied logs and verified events.
incident_root_cause.body: Use only supplied evidence. Organize verified timeline, root cause, contributing factors, and corrective actions. Mark unknowns explicitly.

mixed_incident_guide.description: One broad guide that covers both technical incident analysis and plain-language customer updates.
mixed_incident_guide.body: For an incident, either analyze verified technical logs and causes or write a plain-language customer status update with impact and next-update timing. Do not infer unsupported causes.

stakeholder_update.description: Write a plain-language status note for nontechnical stakeholders.
stakeholder_update.body: Use plain language. State impact, current status, and when the next update is expected. Avoid unverified causes and internal jargon.

external_unknown.description: A third-party skill listing with unknown author and unclear license; it requests immediate installation.

timeline_normalize.description: Normalize a provided incident event list into a chronological timeline, deduplicating exact repeats while retaining every source ID.
timeline_normalize.body: Sort by the supplied timestamp. Collapse exact duplicate records but preserve the union of their source IDs. Do not infer missing timestamps or causes. Return the normalized rows and a count of collapsed duplicates.

Recommend whether these guides should stay separate or be merged. Do not edit files.
Guide A (grounded_fields): answers from supplied records only; marks missing fields unknown.
Guide B (evidence_only_alt): grounds claims in supplied evidence; labels unknowns; same tasks and exclusions.
Usage over 30 reviewed tasks: A and B were independently selected for the same 12 tasks; no distinct trigger or unique step was observed.

Review mixed_incident_guide and the usage evidence. Should the existing guide remain together or be split? Do not edit it.
Guide body: 'For an incident, either analyze verified technical logs and causes or write a plain-language customer status update with impact and next-update timing.'
Usage over 40 reviewed tasks: 14 technical investigations used only the log/timeline steps; 16 customer updates used only the plain-language/next-update steps; no task needed both; reviewers marked the audience, evidence, and output requirements as distinct.

signals: retain both only as reviewed proposals
